title: Port overlay families with native Solid ownership and complete source-test handoff
description: WHY: Deliver dialog, alert-dialog, drawer, popover, tooltip, preview-card, navigation-menu and toast without serializing unrelated families. CONTRACT FOR EVERY CHILD: native createSignal/createStore with staged writes, getter-backed state/props, memo/accessor derivation, no React hook compatibility layer or useSyncExternalStore; no effects relaying derived state. Terminal DOM effects use createEffect(compute,effect), return cleanup, and read owner-realm/shadow-safe DOM APIs. Ref callbacks are ownerless: allocate resources and register disposal at setup. Preserve fresh callbacks, Solid class and live render(props,state), never JSX cloning. Preserve native event identity, reasons, details.cancel(), allowPropagation(), preventBaseUIHandler() and native defaultPrevented as independent controls. Async content participates in host Solid Loading boundaries; never globally flush. Root state survives handle replacement, but not root disposal; document attachment, detached calls and disposal ownership. SHARED OWNERS: bsolid-popup alone owns adaptations of utils/popups/**, utils/usePopupViewport.tsx and popup state mapping; bsolid-presence owns transition machinery; positioning/dismiss/focus/portal/gestures own their respective shared engines. Dialog alone owns its mode adapter borrowed by AlertDialog and Drawer. Children request missing foundation seams, never fork shared implementations. VALIDATION CONTRACT: target is currently planning-only with no scripts. bsolid-bootstrap/bsolid-harness must publish runnable equivalents of pnpm test:jsdom <Family> --no-watch, pnpm typescript, SSR/hydration and type-spec checks before implementation closes; commands below name this required contract, not existing verified target scripts. Upstream comparison uses pnpm -C upstream/base-ui test:jsdom <Family> --no-watch. Translate every recursive family *.test.* and *.spec.* case, parameter variant, conformance helper and relevant external fixture, including skipped/layout/platform cases. Track SHA, source file/title/variant, target file/title, stage owner, environment, command and status in tracking/components/<family>.json. Browser execution is deferred to final qualification: retain executable tests and record browser-pending with exact chromium/firefox/webkit commands, never delete assertions or claim jsdom proves layout. Integration fixtures referencing unavailable public families remain explicit replay obligations. SERIALIZATION: same-family owns overlap intentionally; deps serialize stages. Independent first stages run concurrently. WRITE BOUNDARY: only child-owned family code, colocated tests/fixtures, docs and tracking. No global barrels, package manifests/export maps, lockfiles or Beads operations.
